QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Vanished Star Fragments
QuestInfo.0: Monsters have changed because of the falling star. But there are more things that #p2081000# is worried about. \r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081000# assumed that the falling star didn't just affect the monsters but the forest as a whole. Eliminate monsters that have changed from the power of Star Force and collect the Vanished Star Fragments for #p2081000#.  \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You collected Vanished Star Fragments for #p2081000#, who will run some tests on them.\r\n

0.0: The falling star has changed the monsters... Do you think it's affected the forest as well? I would hate for the forest to grow legs and start walking around, stomping on Halflingers. I need you to investigate.\r\n

yes.0: We have to research those star fragments and learn more. Get some #rVanished Star Fragments#k from hunting local monsters. I believe #b15 fragments#k should be plenty.\r\n

no.0: You'd reject a frail old Halflinger?\r\n

1.0: Ah, you have the Vanished Star Fragments. On behalf of the entire forest, I thank you.

yes.0: I'll study these fragments. I'll contact you when I have something. Thanks.

default.0: You can get #rVanished Star Fragments#k by hunting monsters changed by Star Force powers. I need at least #b15#k.
